protected_time_budget_control.purpose: Use a declared 50-minute sufficiency guard for carers/children and night workers before comparing the all-agent proxy; retain 40 minutes as a diagnostic curve.
protected_time_budget_control.mode_weight_interpretation: Declared synthetic guard profile; not observed local mode share, service availability, accessibility performance or resident preference.
field_gate: dated station lift and accessible-route audit
grouped time-budget OD and resident response
protected_time_budget_control.stop_rule: If either protected group loses the dated field threshold or an equivalent ground/human fallback is absent, hold the policy and return to P0.
